rawContent: Read the replies to this thread. & know David isn’t only man who’s had this question as #MeToo has become a more public convo. I’m 54, & honestly I’m surprised when I talk to a woman who hasn’t  had an incident of harassment, assault, or rape. Especially women of my generation.
@PeteDominick @StandUpWithPete @AlfredSchulz Last year @Alyssa_Milano used the #MeToo @TaranaBurke started several years ago
I’m really pretty done with the (few) men who are trying to take focus off #metoo by making it all about them. Women can’t even fight for change without some men asserting their dominance
